entities.name: Fenofibrate
observations: Fenofibrate can potentiate coumarin anticoagulant effects and requires close INR monitoring with warfarin dose adjustment as indicated.
Fenofibrate labeling supports baseline and periodic renal-function assessment and liver-function monitoring.
Concomitant statin therapy increases concern for myopathy, but routine CK testing is not required in every asymptomatic patient.

entities.name: Warfarin
observations: Warfarin effect may be potentiated by fenofibrate; INR should be monitored closely after fenofibrate initiation.
The presented INR is 1.5, so empiric warfarin dose reduction is not appropriate without anticoagulation-directed assessment.

entities.name: Fenofibrate baseline monitoring
observations: Before fenofibrate initiation, evaluate renal function and liver function; coordinate close INR monitoring when the patient uses warfarin.
Among the listed choices, a renal function panel is the most directly appropriate pre-initiation safety assessment when INR monitoring is not offered as an option.
